folder.archiveBody: {count, plural, one {Archiving “{name}” also archives the # item inside it.} other {Archiving “{name}” also archives the # items inside it.}} Move items out first if you want to keep them active. You can restore the folder later.
folder.deleteBody: {count, plural, one {This permanently deletes the folder “{name}” and the # item inside it.} other {This permanently deletes the folder “{name}” and all # items inside it.}} This cannot be undone.

dev.specHint: Read-only — the native panel/view config persisted for this dashboard. Each panel resolves its governed query at View time (Apache ECharts), so there is no Add panels in the Simple flow to see the full spec.

dev.rlsHint: Each panel-query runs under the viewer’s delegated identity; per-viewer RLS comes from OPA identity so two viewers see different rows. Open View to resolve it.
dev.notViewed: (not yet viewed — open View to resolve it)
dev.rlsSaveFirst: Save and view the dashboard in the Simple flow to see the row-level security here.
